To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed a web application, DNannotator, to annotate a genomic region with local discoveries and to migrate existing annotations in a GenBank format from an existing genomic sequence to a new sequence.

(1) the DNannotator software tool is a web application for batch annotation on a genomic region, which can be used to perform de novo annotation and migrate GenBank-formatted annotations from one sequence to any other, and (2) the annotation results are provided in two formats (text and GenBank) and reference data are optionally provided to facilitate the user's evaluation.
we have developed a tool kit to perform batch annotation for regional genomic sequences and to migrate annotations in GenBank to other sequences.

the annotation and analysis of the genomic sequence.
developing a tool kit that can assist investigators with their genomic annotation and analysis needs.
developing a software tool that can assist researchers in annotation, integration and presentation of genomic sequence information.

the DNannotator software is a useful tool to assist researchers in annotating genomic DNA and to integrate existing genomic annotation.

DNannotator is a user-friendly tool for annotating regional genomic sequences.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DNannotator can help researchers to quickly and easily annotate genomic sequences, which can be used for further analysis and experimental design.
DNannotator provides an efficient and flexible annotation platform that can meet the needs of a broad range of genomic studies.

DNannotator is an easy-to-use, powerful tool that can help users create local annotation for a genomic region of interest and integrate multiple annotations into a single, comprehensive annotation.
